snippet.title: Crimson Animatronic Trailer
snippet.description:
LEARN MORE ABOUT THE HORROR VISUAL NOVEL:

Crimson Animatronic is a chaotic, disturbing and dark humour riddled visual novel where survival relies on your choices and mistakes.

THE STORY:

You play as Daiane, a charismatic werecat and radio host who finds herself in the worst situation imaginable: she is stalked from the shadows by a cult of vampires, the Crimson Order, who she discovers are being hunted down by Charkelene Chan, a wolf animatronic with a mane crimson like blood. Haunted by a vengeful spirit killed and consumed by the Order, he is moved by wrath and pain, stuck to the machine

PLAY THE DEMO:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4702610/Crimson_Animatronic/
